references.text: The name of the Lord is placed over the children of Israel, showing that they belong to Him and are under His protection.
God's name is mentioned over His people, pointing to the same idea that God's people bear His name.
God's name is called upon the people, identifying them as His possession.
The name of the Lord is mentioned over Israel, and they are His people.
God's name is mentioned over the city and the people, showing belonging to the Lord.
The name of the Lord is mentioned over the nations, pointing to the fact that all peoples should know the name of the Lord.
The peoples shall fear Israel because of the Lord, which agrees with them fearing when they see that the name of the Lord is mentioned over them.
Rahab confesses that the peoples fear Israel because they have heard about the mighty deeds of the Lord.
Solomon prays that all the peoples of the earth should know the name of the Lord and fear Him.
